name: Domain Mail Check
tagline: Check SPF, DKIM, DMARC and whether Gmail and Outlook will accept a domain's mail
description: A hosted, keyless MCP server for email deliverability. Pass a domain and it reads the live DNS: SPF, DKIM, DMARC, MX and CAA records, the mail provider, and the domain's registrar and expiry date. It also scores whether a new sending domain is ready for outreach and explains why Gmail or Outlook may reject or spam-folder its mail. Useful when you ship an app that sends transactional mail, or set up a new domain. Read-only: it never changes DNS or sends mail.

install.notes: No API key and no sign-up. Try: "Is DMARC set up for example.com?" or "Will Gmail accept mail from example.com?"
